title: MOSS-Audio: Unified Open-Source Audio Foundation Model
summary: MOSS-Audio is a modular foundation model that unifies speech, environmental sound, and music understanding within a single architecture. It employs a custom-trained CAT audio encoder and LLM backbone to perform complex reasoning and instruction-following tasks on raw audio data.
research_notes: Developed by the OpenMOSS team (Fudan University); features unique time-aware representation for temporal analysis and supports edge deployment via GGUF/ONNX.

evolution.summary: The project rapidly expanded into a comprehensive ecosystem, adding 'Thinking' variants for complex reasoning and 'Instruct' models for production pipelines. It now includes MOSS-TTS for high-fidelity generation and specialized tokenizers trained on 3 million hours of audio.
